<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/subscriptions/{sub}/usage"}
#docs
Send an `Idempotency-Key` header or a body `idempotency_key`. Without a header, the body key is used as the request key for this item. A repeat with the same key and the same values returns the first record. A repeat with the same key and different values is refused with 409.

`timestamp` must be in the period that the next invoice bills: from the start of the current billing period (or of the open pending invoice's usage window, when that is earlier) to 5 minutes after the current time. A timestamp in a period that is already invoiced, before the subscription starts, or more than 5 minutes in the future is refused with 400. The error message gives the accepted window. For a time-travelled test business, the current time is its simulated time.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `sub` | `string` | **yes** | Subscription id (sub_…) |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `item` | `string` | **yes** | The subscription item's id (si_…). |
| `quantity` | `integer` | **yes** | From -10^12 to 10^12. Negative only for a recurring sum or a weighted_sum price (a delta that lowers the level). |
| `unique_key` | `string` | no | For `unique` aggregation (e.g. distinct user id) |
| `operation` | `string` | no | `remove` takes `unique_key` off a unique metric (a seat leaves). Only for a unique price, and needs `unique_key`. One of `add`, `remove`. Defaults to `"add"`. |
| `timestamp` | `string · ISO-8601` | no | When the usage happened (ISO-8601 UTC). Default: now. It must be in the period that the next invoice bills, and not more than 5 minutes in the future. |
| `idempotency_key` | `string` | no | Identifies this usage event on this item. It is the request key when there is no `Idempotency-Key` header. A reuse with different values is refused with 409. |
| `note` | `string` | no | Operator note, returned by the usage API and never printed on a customer document. Echoed in this response only when set. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `usage_record`. One of `usage_record`. |
| `id` | `string` | The usage record id. |
| `item` | `string` | The subscription item id. |
| `quantity` | `integer` | The quantity recorded. |
| `operation` | `string` | Present only for a remove. |
| `timestamp` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the usage happened. |
| `note` | `string` | The note on the event, if you sent one. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `201` | Usage recorded |
| `400` | The body is not correct, the timestamp is outside the accepted window, or there is no idempotency key |
| `404` | No such subscription/item |
| `409` | The idempotency key is in progress, or was used before with different values |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/subscriptions/sub_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/usage" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "item": "si_XXXXXXXXXXXX01",
    "quantity": 1
  }'
```
